backingFixtures.note: Generates a real SQLite .arq through the canonical ARQFS/project-format writers. The proof test reopens it through ARQFS, imports the archive, and decodes it through apps/web's native-project-model boundary before asserting every protected scale dimension.
This renderer scene remains the renderer-specific scale proof. It must not be substituted for product-executable workflow evidence.
The independently authored golden fixture remains the compatibility control. It is smaller than Core scale and must not be reported as Core-scale workflow evidence.

mutationRule: Any reduction below an exact/minimum guard is a failing fixture change. Complexity may increase only with an explicit #402 budget review.

guardCoverage.rule: Every protected dimension is mechanically verified against the generated product-executable .arq fixture. Workflow evidence must still name the actual evidenceFixture used; product-executable scale does not make renderer-only or compute-only measurements Core E2E evidence.
